name: Table
description: Generic, content-agnostic row/column layout — a rounded card with a labeled header row above a stack of data rows. Composed from Table.Head (Table.HeaderCell per column), Table.Body (Table.Row, each holding Table.Cell per column). Column widths and alignment are set per Table.HeaderCell/Table.Cell; cell content and its typography are entirely up to the caller — text, an icon + label, a badge, an icon button, anything. Table.Row accepts an optional onClick for a hoverable/keyboard-activatable row.
figmaReference: https://www.figma.com/design/sw2QyHTScXTOrCykzYZCdX/-WEB--Decoy-Dashboard?node-id=2926-25590 — content mockup only, not yet a published component in the [WEB] Design System library; fill in figmaFileKey/figmaNodeId once Table exists there and wire up table.figma.tsx
